_what: THE INTAKE GATE. One entry per panel or table that supplies a VALUE. Filled BEFORE any digitiser was written.
_why: The two curations that took their values from a publisher Source Data file (NG_2025) and from the authors' own repository (WT_2026) have ZERO digitisation defects between them. The four that digitised have eight value-changing findings: F-006, F-008, F-017, F-018, F-019, F-020, F-033, F-040.

_tiers.1_publisher_source_data: a Source Data file published with the paper
_tiers.2_si_tables: an xlsx/csv/docx table in the supplementary information
_tiers.3_author_repository: the authors' own repo, Zenodo, Dryad, figshare
_tiers.4_pdf_text_table: a real text table inside the PDF (pdfplumber)
_tiers.5_pixels: digitised from a figure. THE LAST RESORT.

_rule: A panel recorded as 5_pixels MUST fill why_tiers_1_to_4_failed with a sentence a reviewer can check. 'Not available' is not such a sentence.

tier_1_to_4_sweep._what: What was actually looked at, and what it contained. Recorded so a reviewer can re-run the same four checks instead of taking the 5_pixels verdict on trust.

1_publisher_source_data.evidence: The PMC JATS record lists exactly ONE supplementary-material element for this article: <media xlink:href="SMLL-21-2405618-s001.docx"/>, which is the SI Word file already held. Wiley's article landing page lists the same single supplement. There is no Source Data file, no xlsx, no csv.

2_si_tables.result: EXHAUSTED -- three tables, NONE of which carries a delivery value
2_si_tables.evidence: word/document.xml holds exactly three <w:tbl> elements, all read in full: Table S1 = substructure fingerprint dictionary (19 rows: FP bit, description, SMARTS); Table S2 = composition of LNP types 1-6 (N/P ratio, mass ratio, molar ratios); Table S3 = zeta potential in mV for the 36 selected LNPs plus a positive control. Zeta potential is a physicochemical property, not a delivery measurement, and the corpus's own in-vivo definition explicitly excludes diameter/zeta/uptake (CLAUDE.md s9, 2026-07-23). So the SI tables supply formulation metadata and nothing else.
2_si_tables.used_for: Table S2 supplies every formulation column emitted (N/P, mass ratio, molar ratios, phospholipid identity). Table S3 is held but NOT emitted as a value row.

3_author_repository.evidence: provenance tooling find_repo.py run on 2026-11-10 with --doi 10.1002/smll.202405618 --pmid 39264000 --title 'Rational Design Lipid Nanoparticles' --author Nam: six GitHub queries (DOI code search, PMID code search, four repo searches). Zero candidate repository mentions this DOI or PMID; the surviving candidates (nahisaho/aira_experiments, 9000git/KAN-LNP, Noora68/PLiCat, SeongminHA/...exosome-mimetic...) are unrelated projects matched on the generic phrase 'rational design lipid'. The paper's own Data Availability Statement reads, verbatim: 'The data that support the findings of this study are available from the corresponding author upon reasonable request.' -- i.e. the authors state there is no deposit.
3_author_repository.artifact: find_repo output reproduced in 07_qc.json under checks.repo_sweep

4_pdf_text_table.evidence: The PMC article PDF (9 pages) has no tables at all: the article's three tables are the SI's, and every figure in the PDF is an embedded raster (each page carries at most 9 drawing paths, at most 7 of them stroked, so there is no vector text table and nothing for chains.vector_bonds to read either).

panels.why_tiers_1_to_4_failed: Tiers 1, 3 and 4 do not exist for this paper (see tier_1_to_4_sweep: no Source Data element in the JATS, no repository found by a six-query GitHub sweep, Data Availability says 'upon reasonable request', and the PDF contains no text tables). Tier 2 was exhausted: the SI's only three tables are the fingerprint dictionary, the LNP composition table and a zeta-potential table -- none of them holds a delivery value. The per-lipid I.D. expression exists in this paper ONLY as a drawn heatmap.

panels.panel: Table S2 -- composition of various lipid nanoparticles
panels.supplies: Formulation metadata for every emitted row: N/P ratio, mass ratio, and the molar ratios of ionizable lipid, phospholipid (DSPC or DOPE), cholesterol and DMG-PEG2000, for LNP types 1-6.
panels.locator: the 2nd <w:tbl> in word/document.xml of the SI .docx; 8 rows incl. two header rows.
panels.verified_against: Fig 2g-2l's printed group sizes, which partition 213 by exactly these six compositions and reconcile to the row: type1 n=76, type2 n=25, type3 n=26, type4 n=76, type5 n=3, type6 n=7, sum 213.

panels.panel: Fig 3a -- 'Schematic diagram of the 36 ionizable lipids'
panels.supplies: NO VALUES. The drawn structures of the six functional heads FH-1..FH-6, the three ester bridges EB-5..EB-7 and the two tails T-1, T-2. This is the ONLY place in the paper where FH-1, FH-2, FH-4 and FH-6 are drawn at all.
panels.locator: source/pdfimg/fig3_1590x2450.png -- lossless PNG, the article PDF's own embedded stream.
panels.why_tiers_1_to_4_failed: n/a for values. For the structures: the SI's synthetic procedures name the reagents for FH-5 (3,5-dihydroxybenzoic acid), FH-3 (no head; the free primary alcohol), EB-5/6/7 (glutaric/adipic/pimelic anhydride) and T-1/T-2 (2-hexyl-1-decanol / 2-octyl-1-dodecanol), so those blocks come from NAMED REAGENTS and not from pixels. FH-1, FH-2, FH-4 and FH-6 appear in no procedure, no reagent list, no HRMS and no NMR assignment, so the drawing is the only evidence that exists.
panels.verified_against: Fig 3c, Fig 4d and Fig 4f each redraw the same six heads as panel insets -- three further renderings; and FP3 (tertiary carbons) = 3 on exactly 36 of 213 LNPs in Fig 2b, which is the count of FH-1 LNPs and independently confirms that FH-1 is branched at the alpha carbon while FH-2..FH-6 are not.

panels.supplies: NO ROWS. EE is a formulation property, not a delivery measurement; the corpus excludes it on the same grounds as zeta potential.

panels.panel: Fig 4f / 4g and Fig S4 -- total IgG, IFN-gamma ELISpot, IgG1/IgG2a, TNF-alpha, IL-2
panels.supplies: NO ROWS AS CURATED. These are the VACCINE readouts (antibody titre and T-cell response) and they are a different experiment from the expression screen -- different mRNA (HPV E6/E7 rather than RLuc or hEPO), different schedule (prime/boost one week apart, read one week after the boost, rather than a single injection read at 6 h), different route and different units. They are recorded here so the distinction is on the record, not because they were skipped by accident.
panels.why_tiers_1_to_4_failed: n/a -- not emitted. See DECISIONS.md D-3: these panels cover a SUBSET of the 36 (the figure groups them), the y-axis units are printed per panel and must not be converted, and whether an antibody titre belongs in a delivery corpus at all is not this curation's call.
